summary: This is an SSH configuration file (likely ~/.ssh/config) that defines connection profiles for multiple servers. It sets up two environments for MyAmazingApp—a production server and a test server—plus a third host, each with their own hostname and login username. The extensive comments document what software versions run on each and important deployment details like the database setup.

explanations.12: The 'Host' keyword starts a new server profile block; everything indented below it applies to connections made to 'MyAmazingApp_PROD'.
explanations.13: When you connect with 'ssh MyAmazingApp_PROD', SSH will use this actual IP address (1.2.3.4) instead of looking up a DNS name.
explanations.14: This specifies which username to use when logging into this server; without it, SSH would use your local machine's username.
explanations.26: This starts a second host profile block for the test environment, separate configuration from the production one above.
